subject: BrightPath Health — account initialization & environment verification kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@brightpathhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath Health — account initialization & environment verification kickoff

Hi Elena / Samir —

Great to meet you both last week. This thread will be our working kickoff for account initialization and the environment verification steps required for BrightPath's private deployment (VPC + on-prem connectors). I pulled together an initial checklist (attached) and flagged a few items we need from your side to keep the timeline intact.

High-level asks (please confirm by EOD Friday if possible):
- Network ranges: public egress IPs and private CIDR blocks for the tenant environment (we need the /16 or /20 ranges you plan to use).
- KMS ownership: contact for KMS/HSM admin and whether you will provide a customer-managed key or want Redwood to manage a customer-specific key.
- Administrative contacts: primary ops contact for day-0 connectivity and the security contact for the evidence packet (SOC2, syslog retention, audit window).
- Preferred 2-hour window for initial environment smoke test (we propose Tue 2026-08-11 09:00–11:00 PT).

Attachments included: bp-network-scopes.xlsx (network ranges template), redwood-initial-onboard-checklist.xlsx (our canonical intake runbook). I also attached the MPA for signature — if procurement already executed this, please share the signed copy.

Next steps from Redwood: Ben will schedule a 30m technical sync to validate firewall/NAT details, Karthik will run the preflight checklist against the model/sequence length expectations, and I will coordinate the evidence handoff and DocuSign for the MPA.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: BrightPath Health — account initialization & environment verification kickoff

Marissa —

Thanks, and appreciated the clear checklist. A few quick answers below and I've attached a filled network ranges sheet.

- Network ranges: see attached spreadsheet — primary VPC CIDR: 10.48.0.0/16, management subnet 10.48.128.0/20, service subnet 10.48.0.0/20. Public egress IPs will be assigned by our infra team during the final cutover; provisional NAT IPs listed in the sheet.
- KMS: we will use our KMS (Azure Key Vault) and can provide a key alias and service principal. Security will want an HSM-backed key, confirmation next week.
- Admin contacts: operations lead is Samir Patel (samir.patel@brightpathhealth.com), security contact is me (elena.ramos@brightpathhealth.com).
- Smoke window: Tue 2026-08-11 09:00–11:00 PT works for our on-call team.

I uploaded a scanned copy of our internal network diagram to the Drive folder (link below). Procurement asked that Redwood send the final MPA with the agreed-upon redlines; we can sign once the DocuSign link is provided.

Elena
Director, Infrastructure
BrightPath Health

Subject: Re: BrightPath Health — account initialization & environment verification kickoff

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the filled ranges. Two actionable items from infra side before the smoke test:

1) NAT/fibbing: please confirm whether your egress NAT is a fixed set of IPs or a pool that may change during maintenance windows. For our routing config we prefer fixed IPs for the first 30 days; if you can provide a CIDR with static nat we can pin firewall rules.

2) Evidence packet: Kimberly (cc'd) will work with your security team to pull the minimum evidence set we require for onboarding: SOC2 report (latest), encryption-at-rest statement, syslog forwarding confirmation with sample retention policy. If you can drop those into the Drive folder (or share via a secure link), we'll mark them as received. We typically require artifacts 5 business days prior to cutover.

I'll also set up a 30-minute technical sync for Thursday 2026-08-06 11:00–11:30 PT to walk through NAT and KMS trust. Please let me know if that conflicts with your calendar.

All —

Quick status and action items (summary for records):
- BrightPath provided provisional CIDRs and filled network workbook (attached earlier). Ben to confirm NAT static IPs during Thursday sync (scheduled).
- BrightPath will upload SOC2 and syslog retention evidence to the shared Drive by 2026-08-07 EOD. Kimberly to confirm receipt and send an evidence acceptance note.
- KMS: BrightPath to share service principal and key alias; Karthik will run a KMS compatibility check and share recommended key rotation policy.
- DocuSign: Marissa will send the MPA link after procurement confirms redlines; Elena please confirm procurement point of contact if different from your security contact.

Planned timeline: day-0 smoke on Tue 2026-08-11; tech sync Thu 2026-08-06 11:00 PT.

Thanks everyone — if there are any blockers call out now.
